The '''Jawa Data Crystal Information Area''' was a secret [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] stronghold located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in which [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts and [[Optical Information Crystal]]s were stored. The latter were extremely valuable, since they were used by both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In the later stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a Jawa named [[Keemee]] had been tasked by [[Wimateeka]], leader of the [[Nkik clan]], to maintain the facility and protect the valuable data crystals.<ref name="DW" />
